title: Electric Bike Tour in Barcelona
text: Fantastic private electric bike tour in Barcelona with Igor as our guide. We got great insight into the city's sights and can highly recommend Igor and the company.
author: 516jettel

title: Accessible to all with electric bikes!
text: Thank you, Kevin! You made us discover Barcelona from a completely different angle. This city is so rich in history;) We had a great time, a nice break where we took plenty of eyes!
author: IsaDlm

title: Barcelona !!!the best way 🚴🏼‍♂️
text:
Although my confirmation email had the wrong address on it when I finally found the right shop , I am pleased to report I found a friendly and very helpful service .
Igor the guide was informative , fun and supportive of a diverse group of cyclists . The bikes were in very good condition and the tour flowed very well indeed .

It wasn’t particularly hard cycling , Barcelona is a beautiful and very easy city to enjoy from a saddle . The best way to explore  , I would recommend these guys to anyone !!
author: K3740KRpaulb
